IPMotion benchmark: v2 vs v3

Last updated: 2026-10-03 14:14:28 (this page reloads itself every minute)

Model: gemini-3.5-flash for every run shown (2 run(s) on other models excluded, never mixed). Generated 2026-10-03 14:14. Same model, same clean (manifest-only) index and same prompt text for both pipelines; v3 additionally checks each attempt (runtime errors first, then spec conformance, then lint) and feeds back at most 5 problems. v3 prompts start with a LABELS/BANNERS block that scripts must use; v2 runs used the older prompt without it. v2 only sees tracebacks (its final script is linted afterwards for measurement). Nothing was tuned per spec.
